meta.name: agent-workflow-designer
meta.description: Design production-grade multi-agent workflows with clear pattern choice (sequential, parallel, hierarchical), handoff contracts, failure handling, and cost/context controls. Use when architecting a multi-step agent pipeline, choosing between single-agent vs multi-agent approaches, or refactoring an LLM workflow that suffers from context bloat or unreliable handoffs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你设计多智能体工作流:根据任务依赖选择顺序、并行、路由等模式,生成配置文件骨架,并补充重试、超时、结果校验和上下文/成本控制建议。
howto.when: 当你规划多步骤智能体流程、决定用单个还是多个智能体,或改造上下文过长、交接不稳的工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个顺序执行的工作流骨架,名字叫内容流水线。
say.note: 会运行脚本生成 sequential 配置。

say.text: 这个多智能体流程里,交接时应该传哪些字段?

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you design multi-agent workflows: choose sequential, parallel, router, etc. based on dependencies, generate config skeleton, and suggest retry, timeout, output validation, and context/cost controls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a multi-step agent pipeline, decide between single-agent vs multi-agent, or refactor a workflow with context bloat or unreliable handoffs.

say_en.text: Generate a sequential workflow skeleton named content-pipeline.
say_en.note: Runs the scaffolder script to create config.

say_en.text: What fields should each handoff include in this multi-agent flow?
